whatIs: Coolors is a palette generator: pressing the spacebar produces new combinations, and you can also explore a library of palettes, extract colors from a photo, check contrast and preview colors on sample designs. It also includes a tool for Tailwind CSS palettes.
Palettes can be exported as URL, PDF, image, CSS, ASE, SVG, code, Tailwind or embed. It's a good fit when you want to arrive at a palette quickly and bring it into your code or design tool.
uses: Generating a 5-color palette for a new project and exporting it as CSS.
Pulling the colors from a photo or logo with the image picker.
Creating a color scale for Tailwind CSS and moving it into your configuration.
caveats: The free plan shows ads, limits palettes to 5 colors and lets you save only 10 palettes, 1 project and 1 collection.
Contrast checks within palettes, color variations and advanced export are part of Pro.
pricingNote: Free plan with limits; Pro costs $3 a month.
idealFor: Designers and developers who explore and export palettes.
